abetted by husband and in-laws was not rebutted by accused

of the case - Conviction upheld - Crime against woman.

husband and parents-in-law of the deceased tortur.ed the

sheeted and tried for offence under s.3048 and s.498A

imprisonment for three'years. The High Court did not

of the charge punishable under s.3048 IPC, therefore,

of offence under s.498A. It, therefore, held that the
